findings.description: The customer-managed KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation, so it defaults to false and the backing key material is never automatically rotated. Without rotation, a single compromised or leaked key version can be used to decrypt all data protected by this key indefinitely, defeating the benefit of periodic cryptographic key replacement for the audit bucket.
